self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Focus (R5): Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by 16%, max 5 stacks; a CRIT Hit removes all stacks. Modeled at a sustained ~3-stack average (48% CRIT Rate) to reflect the self-clearing nature of the effect.

en.flavor: An old longbow that belonged to the erstwhile aristocratic rulers of Mondstadt. Countless generations later, the bowstring is still tight and can still fire arrows with great force.

refinements.1: Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by <r>8%</r>. Max 5 stacks. A CRIT Hit removes all stacks.
refinements.2: Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by <r>10%</r>. Max 5 stacks. A CRIT Hit removes all stacks.
refinements.3: Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by <r>12%</r>. Max 5 stacks. A CRIT Hit removes all stacks.
refinements.4: Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by <r>14%</r>. Max 5 stacks. A CRIT Hit removes all stacks.
refinements.5: Upon damaging an opponent, increases CRIT Rate by <r>16%</r>. Max 5 stacks. A CRIT Hit removes all stacks.

fr.flavor: Un arc long qui appartenait jadis aux dirigeants de Mondstadt. Après avoir connu bien des générations, sa corde légère est toujours capable de décocher des flèches à une vitesse impressionnante.

refinements.1: Augmente le taux CRIT de <r>8 %</r> à chaque attaque qui cause des DGT à un ennemi. Cet effet peut être cumulé 5 fois maximum et est réinitialisé lors d'un coup CRIT.
